name: 21.QF5

origin.summary: Test 5 of the 2021 CrossFit Quarterfinals. The Quarterfinals sit between the worldwide Open and the Semifinals in the CrossFit Games season — a harder online stage for the top slice of Open finishers.

description: A fast descending 9-6-3 couplet of heavy snatches and burpee box jump-overs over a tall box.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/quarterfinalsindividual/2021/5 (official CrossFit Games Individual Quarterfinals workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
